newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland to issue US bonds in weeks, JP Morgan lead.
newsitem.headline: Poland to issue US bonds in weeks, JP Morgan lead.

text.p: Poland will issue its first U.S. SEC-registered bonds in coming weeks and the issue will be led by JP Morgan, with Merrill Lynch & Co., and Salomon Brothers Inc. as co-managers, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The statement on Tuesday did not give the amount of the issue, but under budget law Poland cannot issue more than $500 million worth of bonds on international markets in 1997.
It said Finance Minister Marek Belka will start road-show presentations in New York on June 23, before going to Chicago, Boston and other locations.
The ministry said Poland had filed a registration statement for debt securities with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
No other details were given and finance ministry officials declined to give further information about the issue. @
